preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each number a_i on the vertices must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(f'{i} {count}\n' for i, count in result if count > 0)
postconditions.description: The output must contain lines for each integer i from 1 to 200,000 that has at least one pair (x, y) with g(x, y) = i, formatted as 'i count'.
